memo:
THIS TURN: Play Steam Vents and let it enter tapped. Don't pay 2 life, because we have no 1-mana play. Cast nothing and pass.
- Turn 2: play Command Tower, then cast Coruscation Mage ({1}{R}) without offspring.
- Turn 3: play Island, then cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}) using Steam Vents for R, Island for U and Command Tower for 1.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier and Coruscation Mage on board by turn 3, with Ophidian Eye on Vivi Ornitier.
- Ophidian Eye does not need Vivi to attack. Her trigger damage is dealt by her, so with the Eye on her we draw a card for each noncreature spell (each opponent damaged gives a "may draw").
- Next: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, a rock (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet), then a second engine (Guttersnipe, Veyran, Voice of Duality, Archmage Emeritus).

WIN PATH: Vivi Ornitier and Coruscation Mage ping each opponent for every noncreature spell. Grow Vivi with cheap spells, tap her for mana, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Aim to close on turns 8-9 against opponent clocks of turns 6-9, so slow the leader.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2 (Hearthhull): land-sacrifice drain, plus Blasphemous Act against our creatures. Remove Hearthhull on sight.
- P3 (Giada): fast flying Angels, no counterspells. Answer Giada or Archangel of Thune if they snowball.
- P1 (Teval): slower graveyard engine. Leave them alone for now and watch for Living Death.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Hearthhull, the Worldseed or Zuran Orb: Arcane Denial on the cast, else Chaos Warp.
- Giada, Font of Hope, Archangel of Thune or Avacyn, Angel of Hope: Chaos Warp.
- Teval's Judgment or Insidious Roots: Chaos Warp only if nothing bigger is out.
- Don't give P3 lifegain.

HOLD:
- Windfall until our hand is nearly empty.
- Chaos Warp for the threats above.
- Once Vivi Ornitier is out, keep {1}{U} up for Arcane Denial against removal aimed at her.

REPLAN IF:
- We draw Sol Ring: cast Vivi Ornitier on turn 2.
- Giada lands on turn 2 with Angels following.
- An opponent drops fast mana into an early commander.
- A board wipe is cast.

THIS TURN: Play Training Center. It enters untapped because we have three opponents. Tap it for {U} and cast Ponder to find lands: keep lands, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet on top, and shuffle if the top three have no land. After the land and Ponder we hold 7 cards, so there is no discard. Keep Temple of Epiphany for later.

TARGET: Next turn, if we drew an untapped land, play it and hold 2 mana for Abrade. Otherwise play Temple of Epiphany (enters tapped) and cast Opt with Training Center. The turn after, with 3 lands, cast Vivi Ornitier. Then add Fiery Inscription, plus Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots. Draw targets: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, lands, Guttersnipe.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier and ping with Fiery Inscription and cantrips. Finish with Crackle with Power or Grapeshot, or go long with Niv-Mizzet, Visionary for card draw. Our clock is turns 9-11, slower than P4's turns 5-7, so we must disrupt P4.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P3 > P2. P4 has Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER out early and is heading for a drain emblem: kill Sephiroth. P3 has Edgar Markov eminence tokens and the Vito combo: kill Vito, Skullclamp or Bloodthirsty Conqueror. P2's board is empty: leave them alone, but kill Giada when she lands.

THREATS & ANSWERS: Cast Abrade (2 mana) on Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER as soon as we have 2 open mana, before P4 gets fodder or a sac outlet. Its own death does not trigger its drain. Save Flame of Anor for Giada, Font of Hope, Vito, Skullclamp or Ashnod's Altar. Don't kill P4's fodder while Sephiroth lives.

HOLD: Keep Abrade for Sephiroth. Hold Niv-Mizzet, Visionary for later; it needs 6 mana.

REPLAN IF: We draw Sol Ring or a signet (cast Vivi a turn early). Sephiroth transforms. P4 lands Pitiless Plunderer or Ashnod's Altar. Someone shows a faster threat.

THIS TURN: Play Island and cast nothing. We end with 7 cards, so no discard. Lightning Bolt cannot be cast yet because we have no red source. Hold Brainstorm ({U}). Cast it at an opponent's end step only if we are missing a land for turn 2 or 3.

TARGET:
- Turn 2: play Mountain, then cast Harmonic Prodigy ({1}{R}).
- Turn 3: play Island, then cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}).
- Turn 4: play Island. Cast Guttersnipe ({2}{R}), then Brainstorm ({U}). Vivi's trigger is doubled by Harmonic Prodigy (2 counters, 2 pings), and Guttersnipe's is doubled (4 damage to each opponent). Then activate Vivi Ornitier for {R}{R} and cast Lightning Bolt at the THREATS target, or at P2's face, for the same triggers again.
- Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, a counter (Counterspell, Arcane Denial, Swan Song), and Sol Ring or Arcane Signet.

WIN PATH: Every spell pings each opponent several times through Vivi Ornitier, Harmonic Prodigy and Guttersnipe. Finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with Vivi's mana, around turns 7-9. That is slower than P2's possible combo (turns 5-7), so disrupt P2.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3.
- P2: sacrifice-drain combo, fastest; Lightning Bolt its key pieces.
- P1: punishes our spells and grows an Army; watch for Orcish Bowmasters.
- P3: slow control; leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Lightning Bolt targets: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER (3/3; kill it before 4 deaths), then Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat or Orcish Bowmasters. Killing one of those while Sephiroth is out costs us only 1 life, which is acceptable.
- Don't Bolt Pitiless Plunderer (1/4).
- Don't kill P2's fodder creatures while Sephiroth is out.

HOLD: Brainstorm for our Vivi turn (see the exception above). Keep {R} up for Lightning Bolt from turn 3 onward when mana allows.

REPLAN IF:
- Sephiroth lands on turn 3.
- We draw Sol Ring on turn 2: cast Sol Ring and Harmonic Prodigy that turn, then Vivi Ornitier plus a 1-drop on turn 3.
- Blue open mana on our Vivi turn.
- Harmonic Prodigy gets removed.

THIS TURN: Play Command Tower. Cast nothing at sorcery speed. During P3's turn, keep Command Tower open for An Offer You Can't Refuse if P3 casts a key noncreature spell, such as Call of the Ring. If Command Tower is still untapped at the end of P4's turn, cast Brainstorm ({U}) looking for lands, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet. Put back the two weakest cards, and keep An Offer You Can't Refuse and Snap in hand.

TARGET: Next turn, play Shivan Reef and cast Harmonic Prodigy (Command Tower for {R}, Shivan Reef for colourless). If we drew Sol Ring instead, tap Command Tower for Sol Ring, then Sol Ring plus Shivan Reef ({R}) for Harmonic Prodigy. The turn after, play Cascade Bluffs and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}). Pay by tapping Shivan Reef for {U} into Cascade Bluffs' filter (yields {U}{R}) plus Command Tower. Then Storm-Kiln Artist, and Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots if drawn. Missing pieces: Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, more lands, and Rhystic Study or Guttersnipe.

WIN PATH: Harmonic Prodigy doubles Vivi Ornitier's triggers: two counters and two pings to each opponent per noncreature spell. Chain cantrips, tap Vivi Ornitier for mana, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Our clock is turns 8-10; the opponents' clocks are turns 6-8.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P4. P3: Sol Ring ramp, and Sauron (6 mana) could land in about 2 turns and taxes every spell we cast; counter his noncreature engines. P1: dinosaur ramp and alpha strike; answer with Blasphemous Act or Cyclonic Rift if drawn. P4: slow graveyard deck; leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS: An Offer You Can't Refuse goes on Call of the Ring, The One Ring or Rhythm of the Wild. It cannot hit Sauron or Pantlaza, which are creatures, and it gives the caster two Treasures. Snap protects Vivi Ornitier; recasting her from hand costs no commander tax. Once Sauron is out, cast fewer, bigger spells.

HOLD: Keep An Offer You Can't Refuse and Snap. Hold Storm-Kiln Artist until Vivi Ornitier is on the battlefield.

REPLAN IF: We draw Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, P3 gets to 6 mana, or an opponent casts Rhythm of the Wild or Wrathful Raptors.

THIS TURN: Play Steam Vents untapped (pay 2 life), then cast Preordain with its {U}. Scry priorities: keep Sol Ring first, then Arcane Signet, Izzet Signet, Talisman of Creativity or Fellwar Stone, then a fourth land or a cheap cantrip. We already hold two Mountains. Bottom cards costing 5 or more. We are tapped out after this, and nothing worth countering is coming yet.

TARGET: Next turn, play Mountain and cast Lightning Greaves ({2}), or a 2-mana rock instead if we drew one. If we have Sol Ring, cast Sol Ring off Mountain and Greaves off Sol Ring. The turn after, play Mountain, cast Vivi Ornitier (1UR: Steam Vents gives the {U}, Mountain the {R}), and equip Lightning Greaves ({0}) at once. Then add Guttersnipe, Archmage Emeritus or Veyran, Voice of Duality.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier with cheap spells, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid by Vivi's mana. That lands around turns 9-10. P3 is fastest, with lethal turns 6-8, so slow them down.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P2 > P1.
- P3: Skullclamp plus token eminence means go-wide aggro and card draw. Aim sweepers at them.
- P2: Giada, Font of Hope builds a cheap flying angel ramp. Kill Giada early when affordable.
- P1: Teval, the Balanced Scale is slow graveyard value. Leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- P3 token swarm: Fire Magic, with Fire ({R}) for 1/1s or Fira ({2}{R} total) for 2/2s. Vivi survives both, since she gets her counter first. Creatures dying while wearing Skullclamp draw P3 two cards each, so fire only when it kills 3+.
- Exquisite Blood, a wipe or Teval's Judgment: An Offer You Can't Refuse.
- Giada, Font of Hope: Fira if it also catches tokens, otherwise Lightning Bolt or Abrade later.

HOLD: An Offer You Can't Refuse. Once lands allow, keep {U} open on opponents' turns after Vivi Ornitier lands. Sigil of Sleep is low priority.

REPLAN IF: P3 fields 3+ tokens (use Fire Magic), a rock arrives (cast Vivi Ornitier with Greaves the same turn), or we miss a land drop (Vivi before Greaves).

THIS TURN: Play Command Tower. Cast Coruscation Mage ({1}{R}) using Steam Vents and Command Tower, without offspring (we can't pay the extra {2}). Pass with nothing held; we have no instant-speed plays this round.
- Next turn: play Island, then cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}) with Steam Vents, Island and Command Tower.
- Turn after: play Temple of Epiphany (enters tapped, scry 1), leaving 3 untapped. Ophidian Eye has flash, so cast nothing main phase. On opponents' turns, hold Arcane Denial ({1}{U}) for removal aimed at Vivi Ornitier. If Denial isn't needed, flash Ophidian Eye ({2}{U}) onto Vivi Ornitier at the end of the turn of the opponent just before us.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier with Ophidian Eye, next to Coruscation Mage, within 2 turns. Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, and Guttersnipe or Veyran, Voice of Duality.

WIN PATH: Pings from Vivi Ornitier and Coruscation Mage for each noncreature spell. Then Vivi's mana into Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. We close around turns 8-9 against opponent clocks of turns 6-8, so slow the leader.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2 (Hearthhull): ramping with Exploration and Crop Rotation toward a land-sacrifice drain, and likely holds Blasphemous Act. Remove Hearthhull on sight.
- P3 (Giada): Segovian Angel already out, fliers we can't block, no counterspells. Answer Giada once Angels start stacking.
- P1 (Teval): slow start. Leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Hearthhull, the Worldseed or Zuran Orb: Arcane Denial on the cast, else Chaos Warp.
- Giada, Font of Hope, Archangel of Thune or Avacyn, Angel of Hope: Chaos Warp.
- Teval's Judgment: Chaos Warp only if nothing bigger is out.
- Never give P3 lifegain.

HOLD:
- Windfall until our hand is nearly empty.
- Chaos Warp for the threats above.
- Once Vivi Ornitier is out, keep {1}{U} up for Arcane Denial on opponents' turns.

REPLAN IF:
- We draw Sol Ring: cast it and Vivi Ornitier next turn.
- Giada, Font of Hope lands and Angels follow fast.
- Hearthhull is cast early off ramp.
- A board wipe hits.
- Coruscation Mage is removed.

THIS TURN: Play Sulfur Falls. It enters untapped because we control an Island. Cast Harmonic Prodigy ({1}{R}), with {R} from Sulfur Falls and {1} from Island. That taps us out, which is fine: no opponent has anything worth a Lightning Bolt yet. Keep Mountain, Island and Island for the next turns.

TARGET:
- Next turn: play Mountain and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}).
- The turn after: play Island (4 lands). Cast Guttersnipe ({2}{R}) first, then Brainstorm ({U}). Harmonic Prodigy doubles both triggers: Vivi Ornitier gets 2 counters and pings twice, and Guttersnipe deals 4 to each opponent.
- Then activate Vivi Ornitier (power 2) for {R}{R} and cast Lightning Bolt at the THREAT ORDER target. That repeats the triggers. The spare {R} is lost at end of turn.
- Draw toward Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, and Sol Ring or Arcane Signet. We have no tutors.

WIN PATH: Doubled Vivi Ornitier and Guttersnipe triggers on every spell. Finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with Vivi's mana, around turns 7-9. P2 can combo around turns 5-7, so disrupt P2 first.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3.
- P2: fastest, a sacrifice-drain combo. Lightning Bolt Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on sight.
- P1: punishes our spells, and a flashed Orcish Bowmasters punishes Brainstorm's extra draws. Bolt Bowmasters or The Great Goblin.
- P3: slow control; leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Lightning Bolt goes to Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER first, then Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat or Orcish Bowmasters. Killing one of those while Sephiroth is out drains us 1, which is acceptable.
- Never Bolt Pitiless Plunderer (1/4).
- Never kill P2's fodder while Sephiroth is out.

HOLD: Lightning Bolt and Brainstorm. Cast Brainstorm only on our Vivi-and-Guttersnipe turn, or at an end step if we are about to miss a land drop.

REPLAN IF:
- Sephiroth lands early: Bolt it at the first chance with open {R}.
- Harmonic Prodigy dies: cast Vivi Ornitier anyway.
- We draw Sol Ring or a signet: cast it and speed up Vivi Ornitier.
- Orcish Bowmasters appears: don't cast Brainstorm until it's gone.

THIS TURN: Play Mountain (untapped), giving 2 mana with Training Center. Keep Temple of Epiphany. Cast nothing at sorcery speed. Hold both mana for Abrade, and cast it (3 damage) on Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER at P4's upkeep, or earlier if P4 acts at instant speed. Its own death does not trigger its drain. We end the turn on 7 cards, so there is no discard.

TARGET: Next turn, play an untapped land if we draw one and cast Vivi Ornitier with 3 mana. Otherwise play Temple of Epiphany and cast Opt. Then add Fiery Inscription, then Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots. Draw targets: lands, Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Guttersnipe, a counterspell.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier with cantrips and ping with Fiery Inscription. Finish with Crackle with Power or Grapeshot, or go long with Niv-Mizzet, Visionary. Our clock is turns 10-12; P4 and P3 are faster, so disrupt them.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P3 > P2. P4: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER heads for the drain emblem and combo; kill it now. P3: Vengeful Bloodwitch and eminence tokens, heading for Vito; remove Vito or Skullclamp. P2: Sol Ring ramp, Giada, Font of Hope soon; kill Giada.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER: Abrade. The recast costs P4 4 mana (tax 2, Jet Medallion -1).
- Giada, Vito, Skullclamp, Ashnod's Altar: Flame of Anor.
- Don't kill other creatures while Sephiroth or Vengeful Bloodwitch lives; each death drains us.

HOLD: Windfall, which refills opponents. Niv-Mizzet, Visionary until we have 6 mana. Flame of Anor for Giada, Vito or Skullclamp.

REPLAN IF:
- P4 sacrifices creatures or gets a sac outlet before Abrade resolves.
- Sephiroth transforms.
- P3 lands Vito or Skullclamp.
- P2 casts Giada.
- We draw Sol Ring or a signet: cast Vivi Ornitier early.

THIS TURN: Play Scalding Tarn, then crack it right away (pay 1 life) for a basic Island, which enters untapped. Keep both Mountains for the next two land drops. Cast Lightning Greaves ({2}: Steam Vents plus Island). We are tapped out after this, which is fine: every opponent is on 1-2 lands and nothing is worth An Offer You Can't Refuse yet.

TARGET: Next turn, play Mountain, cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}, all 3 lands), and equip Lightning Greaves ({0}) at once. The turn after, play Mountain (4 lands). Grow Vivi with cheap noncreature spells first, then tap her for mana. Cast Storm-Kiln Artist ({3}{R}) only if we can still keep {U} open for An Offer You Can't Refuse; otherwise hold the Artist. Missing pieces: Guttersnipe, Archmage Emeritus, Pongify, and a mana rock (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet).

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier with cheap spells, then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot paid with her mana, around turns 10-12. Serra Ascendant and P3 clock us faster.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2: Serra Ascendant is a 6/6 lifelink flier while P2 is at 30+ life. It is the only live clock (no lethal on us yet; we're at 38). Remove it.
- P3: Skullclamp plus eminence tokens make a swarm and a card engine. Sweep only when 3+ tokens die.
- P1: one land, slow. Leave them alone for now.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Serra Ascendant: Pongify or Chaos Warp when drawn. Fire Magic can't kill it while P2 is at 30+ life, since even Firaga deals only 3. Below 30 life it is a 1/1, and Fire ({R}) kills it.
- P3 tokens: Fire Magic in Fire mode ({R}). Vivi Ornitier survives it, because she gets her counter first. Each Skullclamped death draws P3 two cards, so fire only for 3+ kills.
- Exquisite Blood, Akroma's Will, a board wipe or Teval's Judgment: An Offer You Can't Refuse.

HOLD: An Offer You Can't Refuse and Fire Magic. Once Vivi Ornitier is out, keep {U} (or {R}) open on opponents' turns. Sigil of Sleep is filler; cast it only as a cheap Vivi trigger.

REPLAN IF: We draw a rock (cast Vivi Ornitier a turn early). Pongify or Chaos Warp arrives (remove Serra Ascendant first). P3 lands Vito or Exquisite Blood. Serra Ascendant keeps attacking us.

THIS TURN: Play Cascade Bluffs. Cast Harmonic Prodigy ({1}{R}) with Command Tower for {R} and Cascade Bluffs for {C}. That taps us out, which is fine: Brainstorm and Snap are not interaction worth holding up now. Keep Shivan Reef for next turn's land drop. No lethal either way; no opponent has creatures.

TARGET: Next turn, play Shivan Reef and cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}): Command Tower {U}, Shivan Reef {R} (1 damage to us), Cascade Bluffs {C}. The turn after, Harmonic Prodigy makes each noncreature spell give Vivi two counters and ping each opponent twice.
- Cast Preordain ({U}), then Brainstorm ({U}), so Vivi reaches power 4.
- Tap Vivi for 4 ({R} included) and cast Storm-Kiln Artist. It is a Shaman, so Harmonic Prodigy doubles its Treasures.
- Missing pieces: lands, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell or Arcane Denial, Guttersnipe.

WIN PATH: Chain cantrips and Snap for doubled Vivi triggers. Then tap Vivi for a large X on Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. Our clock is about turns 11-13; the opponents' clocks are turns 6-8, so we must answer threats.

THREAT ORDER: P3 > P1 > P4.
- P3: Sol Ring, two Treasures and lands make about 7 mana on their next turn, so Sauron is likely before we can counter anything. He amasses off every spell we cast.
- P1: ramping to Pantlaza. Watch for Rhythm of the Wild and Wrathful Raptors.
- P4: slow graveyard deck. Leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Sauron: targeting him with Snap, Chaos Warp or Pongify costs us a legendary sacrifice (his ward). Don't. Answer him with Counterspell or Arcane Denial on the cast, or with Blasphemous Act or an overloaded Cyclonic Rift.
- Orc Army token: Snap removes it for good.
- Pantlaza: Chaos Warp, Pongify, or Lightning Bolt plus other damage.

HOLD: Keep Snap to protect Vivi; it nets free mana by untapping two lands. Keep Storm-Kiln Artist until Vivi is on the battlefield. If Sauron lands, cast fewer, bigger spells.

REPLAN IF: Sauron resolves, P1 casts Pantlaza or Rhythm of the Wild, Harmonic Prodigy dies, or we draw a counterspell or Sol Ring.

THIS TURN:
1. Play Island.
2. Cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}, no tax yet) using Steam Vents, Island and Command Tower. This taps us out, so Arcane Denial is unavailable until our next turn. Accept this risk: P2 and P3 are tapped out and P1 has one untapped land.
3. Attack P1 with Coruscation Mage (2 damage); P1 has no creatures. Do not attack P2, whose Augur of Autumn 2/3 blocks, or P3, whose Segovian Angel can block.
4. Vivi Ornitier is summoning sick and stays home.

Next turn:
1. Play Temple of Epiphany (enters tapped, scry 1), leaving 3 untapped: Steam Vents, Island and Command Tower.
2. Cast nothing main phase.
3. On opponents' turns, hold Arcane Denial ({1}{U}) for removal aimed at Vivi Ornitier.
4. If Denial is unused by the end of P3's turn, flash Ophidian Eye ({2}{U}) onto Vivi Ornitier.

TARGET: Vivi Ornitier wearing Ophidian Eye beside Coruscation Mage, then Resonating Lute ({2}{U}{R}). Missing pieces: Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots, Sol Ring or Arcane Signet, and Guttersnipe or Veyran, Voice of Duality.

WIN PATH: Each noncreature spell deals 2 to each opponent (1 from Vivi Ornitier, 1 from Coruscation Mage) and grows Vivi. Chain cheap spells, tap Vivi for mana (our turn only, once per turn), then finish with Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot. We are roughly 5+ turns out. No opponent threatens lethal soon.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P3 > P1.
- P2: most mana (Exploration, Augur of Autumn), heading for a Hearthhull drain, and likely holds Blasphemous Act. Remove Hearthhull on sight.
- P3: fliers plus Sword of the Animist ramp. Answer Giada, Font of Hope once Angels stack.
- P1: 7 cards but 2 lands, no blockers. Our attack target.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Hearthhull, the Worldseed or Zuran Orb: Arcane Denial on the cast, else Chaos Warp.
- Giada, Font of Hope, Archangel of Thune or Avacyn, Angel of Hope: Chaos Warp.
- Removal on Vivi Ornitier (Assassin's Trophy, Swords to Plowshares): Arcane Denial.
- Never give P3 lifegain.

HOLD:
- Windfall until our hand is nearly empty.
- Chaos Warp for the threats above.
- From next turn, keep {1}{U} up while Vivi Ornitier is exposed.

REPLAN IF:
- We draw Sol Ring or Lightning Greaves.
- Hearthhull or Giada is cast.
- Vivi Ornitier is removed (recast costs 5).
- A board wipe hits.

THIS TURN: Play Mountain. Cast Vivi Ornitier ({1}{U}{R}) using Island, Sulfur Falls and Mountain. That taps us out, which is acceptable: no opponent has a creature or an engine, and P1 and P3 are tapped out. Keep Island, Island, Brainstorm, Lightning Bolt, Guttersnipe and Cyclonic Rift. Cast no spells before Vivi Ornitier.

TARGET: Next turn, play Island (4 lands).
- Cast Guttersnipe ({2}{R}), then Brainstorm ({U}). Harmonic Prodigy doubles both Wizard and Shaman triggers: Vivi Ornitier gets +2 counters and deals 2 to each opponent, and Guttersnipe deals 4 to each opponent.
- Activate Vivi Ornitier (power 2) for {R}{U}. Cast Lightning Bolt at a real threat, or Cyclonic Rift ({1}{U}) on a key permanent. Either one re-fires the doubled triggers.
- Draw toward Lightning Greaves, Swiftfoot Boots, Counterspell, Sol Ring and Jeska's Will.

WIN PATH: Doubled Vivi Ornitier and Guttersnipe triggers, then Crackle with Power, Jeska's Will or Grapeshot off Vivi's mana. Roughly 3-4 turns. P2 is the fastest, with a combo within its next 2-3 turns.

THREAT ORDER: P2 > P1 > P3
- P2: sacrifice-drain combo, 7 cards and 2 open lands. Lightning Bolt Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on sight.
- P1: Sauron punishes each of our spells. Bolt Orcish Bowmasters or The Great Goblin. Cyclonic Rift The One Ring.
- P3: slow control; leave them alone.

THREATS & ANSWERS:
- Lightning Bolt: Sephiroth first, then Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat or Orcish Bowmasters.
- Cyclonic Rift (single target): The One Ring, Ashnod's Altar or Grave Pact. Never target Sauron with it: its ward counters Rift unless we sacrifice a legendary, and Vivi Ornitier is our only one. Only overloaded Rift ({6}{U}, no targeting) removes Sauron.
- Never kill P2's fodder while Sephiroth is out. Never Bolt Pitiless Plunderer.

HOLD: Lightning Bolt and Cyclonic Rift for opponents' threats. Hold Brainstorm for the Guttersnipe turn.

REPLAN IF:
- Vivi Ornitier is countered or killed: next turn, cast Guttersnipe plus Brainstorm. Recast Vivi when affordable (5 mana).
- Orcish Bowmasters appears: no Brainstorm until it's gone.
- Sephiroth lands: Bolt it. Sauron lands: no single-target answer; hold for a counter or an overloaded Rift.

THIS TURN: If we draw an untapped land, play it (3 mana). Cast nothing at sorcery speed. Hold Flame of Anor ({1}{U}{R}, 5 damage) for Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER. Cast it at P4's upkeep, or earlier if P4 starts sacrificing or casts a sac outlet. If we draw no untapped land, play Temple of Epiphany (tapped, scry 1) and cast Opt (1 of our 2 mana). Flame of Anor is then not castable until our next turn. We end on 7 or fewer cards.

TARGET: Next turn, cast Vivi Ornitier (3). Cast Opt too only if a fourth untapped source exists; Temple of Epiphany played next turn enters tapped. Then Fiery Inscription, then Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots. Draw targets: lands, Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Guttersnipe, Counterspell.

WIN PATH: Grow Vivi Ornitier with cantrips and ping with Fiery Inscription. Finish with Crackle with Power or Grapeshot, or go long with Niv-Mizzet, Visionary. Our clock is about 5 turns; P4 is faster, so slow P4.

THREAT ORDER: P4 > P3 > P2.
- P4: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER has Bitterblossom and Pawn of Ulamog fodder and is heading for 4 deaths and the emblem. Kill Sephiroth.
- P3: Vengeful Bloodwitch and eminence tokens, heading for Vito. Remove Vito or Skullclamp.
- P2: Sol Ring ramp and 5 cards in hand. Kill Giada, Font of Hope when she lands.
